name: Farmuken
backstory: Child of Farlo and Tamuken, in Terfila; grew up around haggles for cart space at the market before..., and picked up a little of Toll Ledger Arrears along the way.

experience.text: Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Heard that Forliamus and Farlo now have a child, Forliarlo.
Heard that Tamuken and Forliazco now have a child, Forliuken.
Heard that Forliazco and Farlo now have a child, Farliazco.
Had a child with Forliazco, named Forliamuk.
Heard that Forliarlo and Forliuken now have a child, Forliukar.
Heard that Farlo and Trezco now have a child, Trezarlo.
Heard that Forliarlo and Tamuzco now have a child, Forliauzco.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Birth Of Darnus is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Birth Of Darnus actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: trails the market stalls before first light, starting to haggle for cart space on his own now, and keeping a rougher copy of the family's toll tally.

arc.premise: Farmuken keeps hearing that birth told a little differently every week at the stalls; he wants to track down whoever was actually there and get one telling right before it flattens into something nobody can correct anymore.
